verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents MCP 'Guides': markdown documents that capture an org's metric definitions and join conventions so AI agents write consistent SQL. That is a lightweight, AI-only version of declaring metrics and joins once. It is unstructured prompt context, not a governed semantic model that SQL queries or BI tools resolve against. missing for 10: structured metric/dimension/join definitions, governance (versioning, ownership, access control) over the model, enforcement so SQL and BI queries answer against the same definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can define a governed semantic model — metrics, dimensions, and joins declared once — that queries and AI tools answer against consistently

citations.quote: Read and write Guides — markdown documents that capture your org's metric definitions, join conventions, and domain context, so agents produce accurate SQL without repetitive prompting
